cohort: The study included 31 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancies (CSP) whose medical records were analyzed.
finding: Local intra-gestational sac methotrexate injection followed by D&C with the aid of a Foley's balloon catheter compression appears to be a safe and effective treatment for CSP, with a 96.8% success rate in this cohort.
